stations.title: Winnie
stations.say: Can the owners go by surname?

stations.title: owners
stations.text: Rows come back in the order they were typed.

captions: Winnie wants the owners in surname order, the way the paper cards are.
The rows come back in whatever order they were typed, so she scrolls to find a name.
You sort the rows by one column or two, and keep only the first few, in four tasks.
Now the phone book runs from A to Z, and Winnie finds a name at a glance.
Same records, now in the order each question needs.
